bizLead_en: From consulting to design and deployment, leasing and maintenance, and operations monitoring — all in one place, tailored to your complex environment.
ceoMessage:
국내 지능형 네트워크 시장을 선도해 온 트리즈엔은, 독자적인 SDN 기술과 지속적인 연구개발을 바탕으로 유·무선 네트워크를 통합 관리하고, 보다 지능적인 네트워크 운영을 위한 기술과 솔루션을 발전시켜 왔습니다.

이제 축적된 네트워크 기술에 AI를 더해, 연결을 넘어 지능으로, 네트워크의 새로운 기준을 만들어갑니다.

트리즈엔은 네트워크 구축부터 AI 기반 운영·관리까지, 지능형 네트워크 운영 환경을 구현하는 전문기업입니다.
ceoMessage_en:
TrizN has led Korea's intelligent network market. Built on proprietary SDN technology and continuous R&D, we manage wired and wireless networks as one and keep advancing the technology and solutions for smarter network operations.

Now we are adding AI to our accumulated network technology — moving beyond connection to intelligence, and setting a new standard for networks.

From network deployment to AI-based operation and management, TrizN builds intelligent network operating environments.

Value · 전문성 · 고객 중심 · 책임 | 맞춤형 컨설팅부터 운영·관리, 자동화까지 고객의 네트워크 전 과정을 함께합니다.

visionLead_en: Total network services optimized for each customer, on the way to becoming the world's largest network service platform.
vision_en:
Mission · Total network services optimized for every customer environment | Tailored to complex and diverse environments, we develop solutions and deliver services covering everything from installing wired and wireless networks to operation, management, consulting and automation.
Vision · Becoming the world's largest network service platform | Not by owning network lines, but through technology and service competitiveness, we aim to be a global network service platform.
Value · Expertise · Customer focus · Responsibility | From tailored consulting to operation, management and automation, we stay with our customers through every stage of their network.
